title: Vintage Spartus Folding Travel Alarm Clock – Brown Case – Wind-Up – Works
descriptionText:
Pre-owned vintage item. Crack in the front plastic/glass cover (see photos). Light surface wear on the case and metal bezel consistent with age. Clock mechanism winds and hands move; alarm function not tested. Sold as-is for parts, restoration, or display.
🕰 Description:
This is a vintage Spartus wind-up travel alarm clock featuring a brown folding case and classic silver-tone face with bold black numerals and green luminescent dots. Designed to fold flat for travel, it opens to stand upright on a nightstand or desk.
A lovely collectible for vintage decor or clock enthusiasts.
⚙️ Features:
Brand: Spartus
Type: Mechanical travel alarm clock (wind-up)
Case Color: Brown
Dial: Silver/cream with black numerals
Power: Wind-up mechanical movement
Functions: Time and alarm
Markings: “China” stamped on back plate
Material: Plastic case, metal back, metal bezel
Dimensions: Approx. 3.5” × 3.5” closed
💬 Notes:
Condition issue: Crack on the clear front cover (visible in photos).
Hands move when wound; alarm and full timekeeping not fully tested.
Ideal for collectors, repair projects, or retro display pieces.
